title: Distinguish post-fence queue-drain failures from Engram cleanup degradation
outcome: A queue preparation or delivery failure after an Engram settings fence is reported as a queue-drain failure, rather than implying that capability revocation or runtime cleanup failed. Keep per-session detail, the pending-Stop detail and existing error status semantics.
acceptance: Post-fence queue preparation/delivery failures are attributed separately from capability revocation/runtime cleanup degradation, with all per-session errors and pending-Stop detail retained.
Behavioral coverage checks queue-only and combined cleanup/drain errors without abandoning later sessions or weakening existing dispatch guards.
